notes.path: d4
notes.text: The London System starts with 1.d4. After 1...d5, White develops 2.Nf3 and brings the dark-squared bishop to f4 before e3 locks it in.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3
notes.text: White develops the king's knight first. Against 2...Nf6, White brings the bishop to f4.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4
notes.text: The London System. The bishop reaches f4 outside the pawn chain, and after 3...c5 White supports d4 with e3.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3
notes.text: White supports d4 and opens a path for the light-squared bishop. Against 4...Nc6, White plays c3 to complete the pawn pyramid.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3
notes.text: The pawn pyramid c3, d4 and e3 is complete. Against 5...e6, White develops Nbd2.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 e6 Nbd2
notes.text: The knight goes to d2 so it never blocks the c-pawn. After 6...Be7, White plays Bd3 and prepares castling and Ne5.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 e6 Nbd2 Bd6
notes.text: Black challenges the London bishop. Stepping back to g3 keeps the bishop active and invites ...Bxg3 hxg3, opening the h-file.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 Qb6
notes.text: Black attacks the b2 pawn right away. White answers with 6.Qb3, defending b2 and eyeing an open a-file after ...Qxb3 axb3.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 Nc6 c3 Qb6 Qb3 c4
notes.text: Black closes the queenside and avoids the queen trade. White drops back to c2 and keeps Nbd2 and e4 in reserve.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 c5 e3 cxd4
notes.text: Black releases the central tension early. Taking back with exd4 opens the e-file and prepares c3, Bd3 and castling.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 e6
notes.text: Black plays solidly without ...c5 yet. White plays 4.e3, keeping the f4 bishop active outside the pawn chain.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 e6 e3 Bd6
notes.text: Black tries to trade off the active f4 bishop at once. White retreats to g3, keeping control of the b8-h2 diagonal.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 Bf5
notes.text: Black copies the London bishop move. White plays e3 and challenges Black's bishop with Bd3.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 Nf6 Bf4 Bf5 e3 e6 Bd3 Bxd3 Qxd3
notes.text: Trading on d3 brings White's queen out smoothly without losing time. After 6...c6, White continues with Nbd2 and castling.

notes.path: d4 Nf6
notes.text: Against 1...Nf6, White stays flexible with 2.Nf3. Against 2...g6, White brings the bishop out to f4.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Nf3 g6 Bf4
notes.text: Against a King's Indian set-up, the f4 bishop controls e5. White builds a calm structure with e3 and Be2.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Nf3 g6 Bf4 Bg7 e3 O-O Be2 d6
notes.text: White plays 6.h3 to create a safe retreat on h2 if Black plays ...Nh5. Then Nbd2, c3 and castling follow naturally.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Nf3 e6 Bf4
notes.text: Black keeps the centre flexible with ...e6. Against 3...b6, White plays e3 and builds a solid position.

notes.path: d4 Nf6 Nf3 e6 Bf4 b6 e3 Bb7
notes.text: Black fianchettoes the light-squared bishop to target e4. White develops with Nbd2 to guard e4 and prepare Bd3.

notes.path: d4 d5 Nf3 c5
notes.text: Black strikes at d4 before playing ...Nf6. White supports the centre with 3.c3 so the pawn structure stays firm after ...cxd4.

notes.path: d4 c5
notes.text: Against the early flank move 1...c5, 2.c3 keeps a strong pawn in the centre. If Black plays 2...cxd4, White recaptures with cxd4.

notes.path: d4 c5 c3 Nf6
notes.text: Black develops the knight to stop e4. White plays 3.Nf3 and brings the dark-squared bishop out to f4 next.
